causes.label: Room or outside weather is hot.
remedies: It’s normal for the freezer to work harder under these conditions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Room or outside weather is hot."

causes.label: Freezer has been disconnected recently for a period of time.
remedies: It takes 4 hours for the freezer to cool down completely.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Freezer has been disconnected recently for a period of time."

causes.label: Large amounts of warm or hot food have been stored recently.
remedies: Warm food will cause the freezer to run more until the desired temperature is reached.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Large amounts of warm or hot food have been stored recently."

causes.label: Floor may be weak, causing freezer to vibrate when compressor is on.
remedies: Placing 2 X 4’s (51 mm X 102 mm) under the length of the freezer will help support it and may reduce vibration.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Floor may be weak, causing freezer to vibrate when compressor is on."

causes.label: Cabinet is not positioned solidly on floor.
remedies: Adjust legs (on Upright models).
See Preparing to install the freezer.
Or use shims for uneven floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Cabinet is not positioned solidly on floor."

causes.label: Freezer is touching the wall.
remedies: Level freezer or move slightly.
See Level Freezers.

symptoms.symptom: Freezer external surface temperature is warm

causes.label: The external freezer walls can be as much as 30°F warmer than room temperature.
remedies: This is normal while the compressor works to transfer heat from inside the freezer cabinet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "The external freezer walls can be as much as 30°F warmer than room temperature."

symptoms.symptom: Longer sound levels when compressor comes on

causes.label: Freezer operates at higher pressures during the start of the ON cycle.
remedies: This is normal.
Sound will level off or disappear as freezer continues to run.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Freezer operates at higher pressures during the start of the ON cycle."

causes.label: Interior needs to be cleaned.
remedies: Clean interior with sponge, warm water and baking soda.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Interior needs to be cleaned."

causes.label: Foods with strong odors are in the freezer.
remedies: Cover the food tightly.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Foods with strong odors are in the freezer."
